description:
Variation or removal of
Conditions 2 (Approved Plans), 3 (Materials), 4 (Article 4 Direction), 5
(Landscaping), 6 (Tree Protection Measures), 8 (Refuse Storage), 9 (Tree
Protection Measures), 10 (Tree Protection Measures), 11 (Drainage Details) and
12 (Biodiversity Enhancements) of planning permission PL/1388/25 dated 17
October 2025 for ‘Demolition of existing house and garage; retention of front
wall; development to provide a detached two storey dwelling with habitable roof
space (1 x 5 beds) with rear terrace; widening of existing access;
landscaping’, to remove duplication and revise the requirements and triggers of
the conditions
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The development hereby
approved shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Arboricultural
Method Statement (9.4, Methods 1 – 12; John Cromar report) and tree protection
plan (S1334-J1-P1 and P2) hereby approved<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
development hereby permitted shall be begun no later than 17 October 2028.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the
following approved plans and documents:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">C368-202A
Site Plan, C368-203A, C368-204A, C368-211A, C368-212A, C368-213A, C368-214A,
C368-215A, C368-216A, C368-217A, C368-218A, C368-251A, C368-252A, C368-253A,
C368-254A, C368-256A, C368-260A, C368-261A, C368-262A, C368-263A, Structural
Assessment Report, Construction Management Plan (Rev 1), Preliminary Ecological
Appraisal: Panorama House, Pinner Hill Rd, Pinner (7 October 2024), Design,
Access &amp; Heritage Statement Rev A (Ten Point Five architecture, 2025), Form
4 – Reasonable Exception Statement, (CIL) - Form 1, Photos, Ohme Home Pro data
sheet [7.4kW] - UK &amp; IE, REPORT regarding the impact on trees of proposals
for development (JOHN CROMAR’S ARBORICULTURAL COMPANY LTD).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
development permitted shall not progress above ground floor damp-proof course
level until full details and samples of the materials to be used in the
construction and finishing of the external surfaces of the development have
been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority,
including:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->(a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->external walls, including facing materials, finishes, bonding and mortar;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">(b) roof coverings, ridge tiles, verges, eaves and associated roof
detailing;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">(c) windows and external doors, including materials, finishes, frames,
reveals, cills and lintels;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">(d) soffits, fascias, rainwater goods and other external architectural
detailing;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">(e) external ground surfacing, including paths, terraces, driveways and
parking areas; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">(f) boundary treatments, including walls, fences, gates and other means
of enclosure.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p>

















</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development shall thereafter be carried out and completed in
accordance with the approved details.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior to the development progressing above damp-proof course level, a
detailed scheme of hard and soft landscaping for the entire site shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The
scheme shall include:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">(a)
planting plans and schedules specifying species, sizes, numbers and planting
densities;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">(b)
details of all proposed tree planting, including species, size and location;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">(c)
the layout of hard landscaped areas, including paths, terraces and other
landscaped areas;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">(d)
details of proposed boundary and interface treatments insofar as relevant to
the landscaping scheme; and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">(e)
an implementation programme for all hard and soft landscaping works.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
landscaping scheme shall incorporate and be consistent with all existing trees
and vegetation approved for retention under the approved plans and
arboricultural documents secured by Conditions 2 and 7.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
approved landscaping scheme shall be implemented in full prior to first
occupation of the development or, in respect of soft landscaping, within the
first available planting season following first occupation, in accordance with
the approved implementation programme.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>























</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">Any
tree, hedge or other planting approved for retention under Conditions 2 and 7
or provided as part of the landscaping scheme approved under this condition,
which within five years of completion of the landscaping works dies, is
removed, or becomes seriously damaged or diseased shall be replaced in the next
available planting season with another of the same species and size, unless
otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">Prior
to the first occupation of the development, details of secure and sheltered
cycle stores (including dimensions, elevations and external materials) shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle
storage shall be made available prior to occupation of the development and
shall be retained thereafter.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">Prior
to the first occupation of the development, details of the secure storage and
collection arrangements for refuse and recycling shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved refuse and
recycling storage facilities shall be provided in full prior to first
occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and made
available for their intended purpose</span><span lang="EN-US" style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-bidi-font-weight:bold">.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The development permitted
shall not progress above damp-proof course level until details of biodiversity
enhancement features have been submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">(a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">the number, type,
specification and location of bird nesting and bat roosting features; and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">(b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">the number, specification and
location of integrated swift bricks within the external elevations of the
dwelling.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>









</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">The approved biodiversity
enhancement features shall be installed in full prior to first occupation of
the development and shall thereafter be retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">Notwithstanding the
provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)
(England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or
without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes
A, AA, B, D, E and F in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out
without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>
